name: ladi-spark
brief: A small sputtering firecracker fuse spark effect, front view, centred: a bright white-hot core dot with a ring of short spiky yellow and marigold-orange spark rays bursting out unevenly in all directions, a few tiny detached orange ember pixels flying off. Hard-edged chunky pixel effect, no soft glow or gradients, no outline on the light. ONLY the spark: no fuse, no cracker, no object, no character, no smoke, nothing below it.
subject: prop
